tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen background behind every layout. Body text (`ink`, `ink-2`, `ink-3`) all read on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised panels: the Coming up sheet, the weather Now card, large buttons, the current hour tile.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `bg`, `surface`, `accent-soft` and every person tint: clock, headlines, event titles.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `bg`, `surface` and `accent-soft`: dates, event times, detail lines, icons in the header.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text on `bg` and `surface`: am/pm, section eyebrows, hour labels, low temps. Only 4.31:1 (light) and 4.00:1 (night) on `accent-soft`, so keep it at 22px+ there, as the week view's Today date does.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 2px dividers between rows, button outlines, the range-bar track and the grab handle. Decorative: about 1.2–1.3:1 on `bg`, so never let it be the only thing that marks a control.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one hue that says now/next: the Next eyebrow, today's column header, precipitation chance, the temperature range bar, tip icons. Orange is used in Day and Evening; Night keeps amber.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Highlight ground for what's next: today's week column, the weather tip callout, the Next card in concepts. Pair with `ink`, `ink-2` or `accent` text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `accent` fill (the timeline's current event block). Light uses white, dark and night use near-black because their accents are light.

tokens.name: photo
tokens.usage: Placeholder fill under the photo slideshow while an image loads, and the empty-panel state.

tokens.name: shell
tokens.usage: Warm desktop admin shell behind the raised content panel.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Translucent dark plate for anything laid over a photo: the place/date caption, photo nav buttons. Same in every theme.

tokens.name: on-scrim
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `scrim` (caption place name, nav chevrons). At least 5.3:1 even over a white photo.

tokens.name: on-scrim-2
tokens.usage: Secondary line on `scrim`: the date and time a photo was taken.

tokens.name: swatch-clay
tokens.usage: Swatch chosen for a person in the manager UI: badge disc fill, the 3px ring around list badges, and the legend pill. Always shown with the person's emoji badge and name, never as colour alone.

tokens.name: swatch-amber
tokens.usage: Swatch chosen for a person in the manager UI. Same usage as `swatch-clay`.

tokens.name: swatch-moss
tokens.usage: Swatch chosen for a person in the manager UI. Same usage as `swatch-clay`.

tokens.name: swatch-pine
tokens.usage: Swatch chosen for a person in the manager UI. Same usage as `swatch-clay`.

tokens.name: swatch-teal
tokens.usage: Swatch chosen for a person in the manager UI. Same usage as `swatch-clay`.

tokens.name: swatch-sky
tokens.usage: Swatch chosen for a person in the manager UI. Same usage as `swatch-clay`.

tokens.name: swatch-iris
tokens.usage: Swatch chosen for a person in the manager UI. Same usage as `swatch-clay`.

tokens.name: swatch-orchid
tokens.usage: Swatch chosen for a person in the manager UI. Same usage as `swatch-clay`.

tokens.name: swatch-plum
tokens.usage: Swatch chosen for a person in the manager UI. Same usage as `swatch-clay`.

tokens.name: swatch-slate
tokens.usage: Swatch chosen for a person in the manager UI. Deliberately near-neutral chroma; the default for Family. Same usage as `swatch-clay`.

tokens.name: tint-strength
tokens.usage: Mix percentage for `color-mix()` deriving a swatch's translucent tint (event cards, legend pills) from `--p`. Matches the former hand-tuned alpha suffixes (24 light, 2E dark/night).

tokens.name: on-person
tokens.usage: Foreground for a letter badge on a solid `person-*` fill when a person has no emoji (the first letter of their name).
